headline.zh: 护理机构入住与账单管理流程

scenario.zh: 护理机构经理处理新入住咨询、床位分配、账单生成和付款追踪
scenario.en: Care home manager processes new enquiries, bed allocation, invoice generation and payment tracking

instruction.zh: 确定本周主要处理的护理服务咨询来源
instruction.en: Determine main care enquiry source to process this week

output.zh: 任务面板显示急性转介记录,标记为高优先级并需快速床位评估
output.en: Task board shows acute referral records, flagged as high priority requiring quick bed assessment

label.zh: 家属直接咨询(长期护理)

output.zh: 任务面板显示家庭咨询记录,AI建议匹配护理等级和可用床位
output.en: Task board shows family enquiry records, AI suggests matching care levels with available beds

instruction.zh: 为新入住居民选择房间类型和护理强度
instruction.en: Choose room type and care intensity for new resident

label.zh: 标准护理 + 共享房间

output.zh: 面板更新床位分配和基础护理计划,费用明细显示每周标准档位
output.en: Board updates bed assignment and basic care plan, cost breakdown shows weekly standard tier

label.zh: 强化护理 + 独立套间

output.zh: 面板更新套间预留和增强护理计划,费用明细显示每周强化档位
output.en: Board updates suite reservation and enhanced care plan, cost breakdown shows weekly premium tier

instruction.zh: 选择账单发送和追踪方式
instruction.en: Choose billing send and tracking approach

output.zh: 预览显示自动发送时间线和AI分阶段提醒计划,减少人工跟进工作
output.en: Preview shows auto-send timeline and AI staged reminder schedule, reducing manual follow-up work

label.zh: 手动审核 + 批量发送

output.zh: 预览显示财务审核检查点和批量发送日期,增强准确性但延长周期
output.en: Preview shows finance review checkpoints and batch send date, enhancing accuracy but extending cycle

instruction.zh: 确认本月关键指标和改进建议
instruction.en: Confirm monthly key metrics and improvement suggestions

output.zh: 文档预览显示床位使用情况、账单汇总和平均收款时长,AI标注改进机会
output.en: Document preview shows bed utilization, billing summary and average collection time, AI highlights improvement opportunities

output.zh: 文档预览显示护理等级分布变化和资源需求预测,AI建议人员配置调整
output.en: Document preview shows care level distribution changes and resource demand forecast, AI suggests staffing adjustments

takeaway.zh: Lottie通过AI整合咨询、床位和账单管理,减少护理机构手动行政工作
takeaway.en: Lottie uses AI to integrate enquiries, beds and billing, reducing manual admin work for care homes
